text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It is I! La rapida y furiosa—the fast and furious—El Condorrr Pasaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: My dream's to become the greatest racer the world's ever seen! I will prove that I am la numero una en el mundo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There's no time to waste looking down at the ground! And looking back isn't allowed either! Watch as I soar across el cielooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
